verdict.rationale: Granola documents a first-party RESTful API for its workspace notes. It gives programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts and AI summaries, with scoped API keys and non-expiring workspace keys for Business/Enterprise admins, and lists agent-building use cases. The evidence describes data access only, so 'driving' the product beyond reading notes is unproven, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: evidence of write/control operations (creating or editing notes, triggering actions), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or endpoint reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
